decision_description: Phase 2 concept alignment recorded for the FIELDWISE MSCA-PF proposal. The concept_refiner mapped the FIELDWISE concept (crop water-stress forecasting; MATE Hungary -> MVCRI Bulgaria -> AgroVIR farmer-field validation ladder; DrR Digital Agronomist MVP) against the eight Tier 2B expected outcomes EO-01 to EO-08 and produced call_binding/topic_mapping.json. Outcomes EO-01, EO-02 and EO-07 were mapped as Inferred through the concept's international/inter-sectoral/interdisciplinary research-transfer mechanism, with stated vocabulary gaps against MSCA career-development language. Outcomes EO-03, EO-04, EO-05, EO-06 and EO-08 were marked Assumed because no direct project mechanism (fellow networking/communication, European Charter for Researchers working-conditions alignment, research-training/supervision quality, organisational attractiveness, feedback of results into teaching) exists in the Tier 3 concept material. Four scope conflicts were logged and left unresolved: CF-01 (mandatory training-activities requirement SR-04/CC-09 absent), CF-02 (mandatory Career Development Plan deliverable SR-05/CC-10 absent), CF-03 (framing mismatch on fellow-development/institutional expected outcomes), and CF-04 (non-academic placement added-value justification CC-05 not yet presented). The mapping and strategic differentiation were recorded to Tier 4, but the Phase 2 gate condition 'No unresolved scope conflicts remain between the concept and Tier 2B' is not satisfied, so the alignment is recorded as durable state rather than as a passed gate. The Assumed outcomes and unresolved conflicts were flagged, not filled with fabricated concept mechanisms.
alternatives_considered: Mark expected outcomes EO-03, EO-04, EO-05, EO-06 and EO-08 as 'covered' by asserting a project mechanism from generic MSCA-PF programme knowledge. Rejected: no supporting evidence exists in Tier 3 project_brief/, and inventing a concept mechanism would violate CLAUDE.md §13.2 (inventing call coverage) and §13.9 (using generic programme knowledge in place of source state); §12.2 requires such elements to be declared Assumed.

Resolve scope conflicts CF-01 and CF-02 at the concept stage by authoring training-activities and Career Development Plan content directly into the concept. Rejected: those are mandatory downstream drafting obligations with no Tier 3 seed; authoring them now would fabricate project facts (CLAUDE.md §13.3) and mask the gap the gate must surface.

Declare a hard Phase 2 gate failure and halt immediately on the unresolved conflicts. Rejected as the recording action: the coverage gaps and unmet conditional (CC-05) are not blocking at the concept stage per the concept_refinement_summary notes; the honest action is to record the alignment with its Inferred/Assumed statuses and carry the four unresolved conflicts forward for resolution before drafting, which the gate evaluator then adjudicates.
tier_authority_applied: Tier 2B expected_outcomes.json (HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json, EO-01 to EO-08); Tier 2B scope_requirements.json (SR-04, SR-05, SR-06) and call_constraints.json (CC-05, CC-09, CC-10); CLAUDE.md §7 Phase 2 gate condition; CLAUDE.md §12.2 status categories (Confirmed/Inferred/Assumed/Unresolved)
rationale: CLAUDE.md §9.4 requires every decision affecting future interpretation and traceability to be written durably to the decision log; the Phase 2 concept-alignment outcome — which outcomes are Inferred, which are Assumed, and which scope conflicts remain unresolved — governs how downstream phases (impact architecture, drafting) must treat each expected outcome and therefore must be recorded, not held in agent memory. The Inferred/Assumed assignments follow CLAUDE.md §12.2: only elements with a traceable project mechanism from Tier 3 evidence were promoted to Inferred, while elements with no located concept mechanism were declared Assumed rather than fabricated (§13.2, §13.3). The four unresolved scope conflicts are recorded so the Phase 2 gate can adjudicate them and downstream drafting knows the mandatory training-activities (SR-04/CC-09) and Career Development Plan (SR-05/CC-10) obligations are still open. Tier 2B governs thematic and outcome scope per the authority hierarchy, so the mapping is bound to named Tier 2B source elements throughout.
